stages.title: You have been appointed Chancellor.
stages.now: Take the job, then choose what you will plan on.

stages.title: Your starting position
stages.now: Choose the forecast you’ll plan on, and your headroom target.

stages.title: What is this Budget for?
stages.now: Tick up to three, in the order they matter.

stages.title: Build your Budget
stages.now: Tick the ways you want, then pay for them.

stages.title: Pay for it
stages.now: Choose who pays. Leave a gap if you mean to.

stages.title: Build the package
stages.now: Move what you want, then go back to the options. Chosen ones are pinned at the top of their groups.

stages.title: Build the package
stages.now: Set the departments, the [flagship] programmes, investment and welfare, then go back. Ministers will tell you what each change means.

stages.title: The forecast arrives
stages.now: Open it and see what it does to your plans.

stages.title: Make the sums add up
stages.now: Tax first, then spending, then headroom.

stages.title: Anything for the speech?
stages.now: Tick up to three, then review your Budget.

stages.title: Your Budget, reviewed
stages.now: Change anything you like, then deliver your Budget.

stages.title: What your Budget means
stages.now: Share it, change something, or play again.
